description: The closed alert `kind` enum (Phase 7 §10, pulled forward from the P9-D plan). `kinds` is the full enum every consumer must recognize; the per-writer lists partition it by single-writer ownership: the flow monitor raises AND auto-resolves `monitor_kinds` (pipeline/flow/monitor.py MONITOR_KINDS), the notify module owns `notify_kinds` (pipeline/notify/repo.py WEBHOOK_FAILED_KIND). The app's EXPECTATION_BREACH_KIND branch and the monitoring UI's kind labels pin against the same lists. Phase 9 appends its kinds here.
